submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 1.5 mm gas gap is recommended as it achieves the best time resolution of 1.278 ns among all compliant options. This represents a significant 0.715 ns (36%) improvement over the second-best option (Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm with 1.993 ns). Mixture-G3, while showing excellent time resolution in preliminary simulations (0.9 ns), must be rejected due to its GWP100 exceeding the mandatory environmental limit of 150. The 1.5 mm gap for G1 is optimal, showing better performance than gaps of 1.0 mm (1.409 ns), 2.0 mm (1.28 ns), 2.5 mm (1.359 ns), or 3.0 mm (1.575 ns). This configuration meets all technical and environmental requirements while maximizing detector performance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 at 1.5 mm achieves 1.278 ns, the best time resolution among all environmentally compliant options (G1 and G2). G3 is excluded due to GWP100 violation.
